thread:
rachel (marketing): quick question 10 planning to go live with the release post + benchmark writeup same day as canary. what's our public rollout window so we can set embargo and webinar invite times?

diego (eng): thinking Thu 09:30 PT start for canary, 90m window. final cut by Wed 17:30 PT. ops says we'll watch p99 and error rate.

tess (docs): finishing the release page now. i'll have the canonical docs URL and a short reproducibility section ready. tentative doc URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.2.0 (will update once merged).

rachel (marketing): thanks. we need the exact changelog link and the docs link to include in the announcement and in the webinar slides. diego, can you confirm changelog path and any ops blurb we should publish about the canary fallback?

diego (eng): i'll publish the changelog to the release branch after the freeze: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/blob/main/release-1.2.0/CHANGELOG.md — i'll paste the final public permalink when it's created. ops blurb: canary for 90m, automatic rollback if errors > 1.5% or p99 > 1.8x baseline.

vik (product): for messaging, let's call the benchmark "cost-per-token improvement" and include a short note about test workload. maria, any preferences on how granular we get with numbers?

maria (growth): keep headline numbers in the post, detailed charts in the writeup. share anonymized harness (repo link) and a short YAML sample in docs. avoid infra provider-specific details.

tess (docs): adding a reproducibility snippet now. sample YAML i'll include: ```yaml
benchmark_workload: gen_and_embed
sequence_length: 512
dynamic_batching: true
quantization: q3_k
```

rachel (marketing): great. other checklist items: webinar RSVP link, press embargo note, social copy. can we lock the webinar to 30m after canary end so we can surface early learnings?

diego (eng): that's fine, but ops might still be in monitoring after rollback window. recommend webinar at 30-60m after canary end, label as "initial findings" not "final".

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout release/1.2.0 -> canary at 2026-03-25T16:30:00Z (90m canary). deployment id: rwd-deploy-242.

rachel (marketing): perfect. i'll draft the post with placeholders and send for review. tess and diego please paste final merged links here when ready so i can update the draft and the email embargo. target to send to editorial by Wed 20:30 PT.

tess (docs): docs merged: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.2.0/ and reproducibility guide at https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.2.0/repro. added YAML and brief guidance on what to redact.

diego (eng): changelog permalink published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/releases/tag/v1.2.0. added ops blurb to changelog. good to go from eng side.

rachel (marketing): awesome 1 :heart: sending draft for review now. tagging editorial + growth. will attach benchmark charts and anonymized harness link in the writeup. thanks everyone!
